args: Inside, the hearth woodpile only accepts a split log when the crosshair is exactly on the two-log rack (a small target in the corner left of the hearth); aiming at the floor right in front of it says 'Stack it on the woodpile... (E)' but E does nothing. Same at the outdoor log-round pile and the split halves by the block: needed several nudges before the name appeared.
Crosshair sits squarely on the top log of the hearth woodpile but the target reads 'Floorboards'; the woodpile's pick area does not match its visible logs (pitch -63, yaw ~300, at x~0.9 z~-1.6).

A split half that falls to the ground beside the chopping block is hidden behind the held axe and is only picked up with the crosshair exactly on it; E with it ~8 degrees off picked nothing (no 'nearest within 12 degrees' forgiveness here).

Shovelling ash: standing 0.6m from the hearth, the 'Cold hearth' target only registers in a narrow pitch band (about -46 to -50 deg); at -52 deg the crosshair is visibly on the firebox floor between the andirons yet reads 'Floorboards', above -45 it reads 'Chimney stones'. From 1.3m it says 'Too far to reach' though interact range is 2.2m. No visible ash heap in the firebox to aim at.

Crosshair squarely on the kindling bundle lying on the ground next to the chopping block (pitch -49, ~1m away): no target name appears and E does nothing. A moment earlier, from slightly farther, it read 'Kindling - Carry it to the hearth (E)' but not in reach.

Taking a split log from the full hearth woodpile (4 of 4, ticked) for the andirons un-ticks the first Kindle checklist item, back to '(3 of 4)'. The woodpile hint even invites it ('Stacked. E takes a log for the fire.'), so the player is punished for following it and has to go back out and split a fifth round. Either the andiron log should not count against the stack, or the checklist should say 4 for the pile plus 1 for the fire.

Ada's arrival: 'Ada's wagon is coming up the trail' and 'Ada Lark is here' fire on the same tick (45235), and 3 s later she is already seated in the rocking chair. I never saw a wagon on the trail or her walking in; the arrival the line promises happens off-screen. Crosshair on Ada reads 'Log wall' (she has no name target).

After the reveal (dusk, fire lit): Ada in the rocking chair is small and very low-poly with a flat red body, and the crosshair on her says 'Log wall' (no name or line). Chimney stones beside the firebox are lit to flat, saturated yellow slabs that read as a texture glitch rather than firelight; the room beyond the hearth is mostly black at 5:46 pm even with the lantern on.
